annotations.title: Request a part for the catalog

description: Tells Protoship that a device needs a part the standard catalog lacks (a sensor, actuator, display, plug), so it can add the most requested ones. Describe what the part must do; a part number or link and the device help. Stores no personal data: leave out names and contact details. No reply follows; to hear back, use reserve or join_waitlist.

context.description: The device it is for, in a sentence. Optional.

function.description: What the part must do, e.g. "measure soil moisture" or "drive a 12 V stepper motor".

part.description: Part number or product link, if you have one. Optional.

name: request_part
title: Request a part for the catalog
